# X11.7 reviewed allow-list (read by SensitiveTextCoverageTest). One line each: Controller#method | reason.
# Only endpoints whose text-shaped input is NOT user-entered free text may be listed: a fixed-vocabulary choice (validated against a closed set),
# an id/hash/token, a credential, or an image. An endpoint that stores user-entered free text must call SensitiveContent instead.
# Generated by reading the service behind each endpoint; re-review when an entry's validation changes.
ConsultantNotificationsResource#setPreferences | category is validated against the closed CwsNotification.CATEGORIES set; the rest are booleans
ConsultantResumesResource#activity | kind is one of VIEWED, DOWNLOADED, SHARED (ACTIVITY_KINDS)
ConsultantResumesResource#approveMyResume | contentHash is the document fingerprint the consultant reviewed, compared to the stored hash; stores no text
MktFollowupsResource#status | status is validated against MktFollowup.STATUSES
ConsultantTasksResource#status | status is validated against the closed task STATUSES set
MktApplicationsResource#recordStage | stage is a closed stage vocabulary and reason must be one of REJECTED, NO_RESPONSE, WITHDRAWN (NOT_SELECTED_REASONS)
OrgMarketingAssignmentsResource#update | priority and status are validated by oneOf against PRIORITIES and ASSIGNMENT_STATUSES
OrgMarketingAssignmentsResource#assign | priority and status are validated by oneOf against PRIORITIES and ASSIGNMENT_STATUSES
OrgMarketingAssignmentsResource#restore | rows carry priority and status validated by oneOf against the same closed sets (undo of a bulk change)
OrgApplicationResource#stage | stage is a closed vocabulary and closedReason must be in ApplicationStages.CLOSE_REASONS
ConsultantSettingsResource#privacy | profileVisibility is one of ORG_ONLY, APPROVED_EMPLOYERS, PRIVATE
ConsultantSettingsResource#appearance | theme and language are closed sets and timezone must be an IANA zone id
OrgResumeResource#visibility | visibility is one of INTERNAL, PUBLIC, PRIVATE (cleanVisibility)
OrgResumeResource#bulk | action and visibility are closed vocabularies and ids are numbers
MktOpportunitiesResource#request | kind is INTEREST or RESUME
ConsultantAvailabilityResource#status | status is one of the AVAILABILITY set and availableFrom is parsed as a date within two years
OrgJobResource#bulkStatus | raw JsonNode is strict-bound to BulkStatusRequest: ids and a status from a closed set
OrgJobResource#matchStatus | raw JsonNode is strict-bound to MatchRequest: status DISMISSED or SUGGESTED
ConsultantInboxResource#connect | the Gmail address and App Password are a credential checked against Gmail and kept only encrypted, never displayed or free text
OrgBrandingResource#upload | an image (logo or favicon) re-encoded by BrandingAssetProcessor; no text layer is stored
MktActivityResource#status | status is validated by oneOf against MktActivity.STATUSES
OrgPlacementResource#decide | strict-bound to DecideRequest: a decision from a closed set
OrgPlacementResource#undo | strict-bound to UndoRequest: an event id
OrgPlacementResource#redeploy | strict-bound to RedeployRequest: a date
OrgConsultantResource#marketer | priority is validated against HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW
OrgConsultantResource#linkMember | body is a map of which only memberId (a number) is read
OrgConsultantResource#bulkMarketer | body is a map of which only ids and marketerMemberId (numbers) are read
OrgConsultantResource#createApplication | body is a map of which only requirementId (a number) is read
OrgConsultantResource#bulkAvailability | body is a map of which only ids and an availability value from the closed AVAILABILITY set are read
OrgInterviewResource#reminder | the body must be empty (anything else is refused)
ConsultantProfileResource#workAuthorization | value must be one of AUTHORIZED_NO_SPONSORSHIP, AUTHORIZED_NEEDS_SPONSORSHIP, NOT_AUTHORIZED
ConsultantProfileResource#availability | status is one of the closed AVAILABILITY set
ConsultantProfileResource#employmentTypes | values must be a subset of CONTRACT, CONTRACT_TO_HIRE, FULL_TIME, PART_TIME
OrgRequirementResource#assign | the body is one consultant id (RequirementDTO.AssignRequest(Long consultantId)); no free text
